# Storm-conditioned skill: # pooled_nse is computed over the days IN EACH BIN
WY2017+WY2023 flood test windows: pooled across basins -- it is NOT comparable to a whole-record per-basin NSE; a small bin has its own (possibly small or near-zero) obs variance
which makes NSE noisy/undefined for rare bins.
